indicator_name: Gross regional product volume index, by region, year-to-date
description: Индекс физического объёма валового регионального продукта, нарастающим итогом с начала года
unit: % of the same period of the previous year, year-to-date
methodology: Year-to-date columns «I квартал YYYY года», «I полугодие YYYY года», «9 месяцев YYYY года», «YYYY год»; they begin with «9 месяцев 2011 года» (2001–2010 are annual only, in GRP_VOLUME_INDEX_BY_REGION), hence years_from 2011; through 2026 Q1 on 2026-09-23.
transformation: as published: the year-to-date period (January-March, January-June, January-September, the year) in % of the same period of the previous year -- not converted to discrete quarters
